disclosure: Post-hoc exploratory development-only analysis; not preregistered confirmatory inference.
All paired CIs are conditional on previously selected configurations and are not selection-adjusted.
Intervals are pointwise 95% percentile intervals with no multiplicity adjustment.
economic_group_id clusters are sampled with replacement; each replicate uses identical cluster draws for every model.
AP means average precision; ROC-AUC is secondary. Delta direction is model A minus model B.
No fixed-L2 MLP artifact exists. The only existing fixed-L2 PCA-matched control is logistic regression; no new model was fitted.
Existing pre-defined QNN variants are shown descriptively without new tuning, reranking or inferential claims.
Seed mean, sample SD and range are descriptive statistics from exactly three existing seeds, not confidence intervals.
Only OOF validation years 2015-2020 are read. No 2021-2024 row, prediction, feature, target, holdout or test artifact is opened.
No model fit, refit, prediction generation, new seed, tuning, ensemble, split change, calibration or threshold change is performed.
